description: Defines the ClaimRequest entity class for ORM mapping, including properties related to claim requests such as employee, user, claim event, currency, status, and timestamps. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database interaction and includes getter and setter methods for properties.

classes.name: ClaimRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim request in the HRM system, with properties for employee, user, claim event, status, timestamps, and related ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the claim request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the claim request.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with the claim request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the claim request.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User who added the claim request.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User with the claim request.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID for the claim request.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID for the claim request.

methods.name: getClaimEvent
methods.description: Returns the ClaimEvent associated with the request.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Associates a ClaimEvent with the claim request.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the claim request.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the claim request.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the currency type associated with the claim request.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Associates a currency type with the claim request.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the claim request is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks or unmarks the claim request as deleted.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the claim request.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the claim request.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the submission timestamp, if any.

methods.name: setSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the submission timestamp.
